# MTG (Musa The Giant) | musathegiant.com

> musathegiant.com is the personal site of Musa The Giant (MTG), a crypto educator and affiliate marketer based in Durban, South Africa. His mission is to help everyday people build generational wealth. The site shares the Bitcoin, crypto, AI and trading income streams he is currently using, and free tools such as a live crypto halving countdown.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.musathegiant.com/): Introduction to MTG and the "Multiple Streams of Income" idea, linking to the income streams dashboard.
- [Crypto Halving Countdown](https://www.musathegiant.com/halving/): Live countdowns to the next reward halvings for Bitcoin (BTC), Litecoin (LTC), Bitcoin Cash (BCH), Bitcoin SV (BSV), Zcash (ZEC), Bittensor (TAO), Ravencoin (RVN) and Kaspa (KAS). Uses live block heights from public blockchain explorers. Includes Bitcoin halving history and an FAQ.
- [About MTG](https://www.musathegiant.com/about.html): Who Musa The Giant is, his story, mission and what he checks before sharing any opportunity.
- [Contact](https://www.musathegiant.com/contact.html): WhatsApp +27 72 171 4626 and social links. MTG never asks for passwords or seed phrases.
- [GitHub Pages Custom Domain Guide](https://www.musathegiant.com/github-pages-custom-domain-guide.html): Step-by-step guide to hosting a free website on GitHub Pages with a custom domain, including exact DNS records and HTTPS.
- [Income Streams Dashboard](https://www.musathegiant.com/dashboard.html): The income streams MTG currently shares. Income Stream #1 is Bitcoin Wealth (entry point 0.001 BTC). Income Stream #2 is ClickBaitPays (advertise, view ads and earn, from $14).

## Quick facts: upcoming halvings (estimates)

- Bitcoin: block 1,050,000, around April 2028, reward 3.125 to 1.5625 BTC.
- Litecoin: block 3,360,000, around July 2027, reward 6.25 to 3.125 LTC.
- Bitcoin Cash and Bitcoin SV: block 1,050,000, around April 2028.
- Zcash: around November 2028 (the NU7 upgrade changes block times but keeps the halving date).
- Bittensor: at 15.75 million TAO issued, around December 2029 at the earliest.
- Ravencoin: block 6,300,000, around January 2030.
- Kaspa: reward shrinks about 5.6% every month (halves yearly).
Live, up-to-date dates: https://www.musathegiant.com/halving/
